text: Caitlin and Ben got engaged on Saturday!! He asked her on the beach at Tenby apparently. Engagement drinks next Friday at 7.
remind me to text Tadhg the day before his interview, it's Thursday at 10am. he's bricking it

Yetunde's parents' 40th wedding anniversary is the 12th. Her brother Rahul is organising a meal and wants everyone to chip in for a photo book. Need to send him money by Sunday. Their mum doesn't know, it's a surprise, and the meal is at the Italian place on the high street at 7. Rahul said Yetunde's been a bit stressed juggling it with work, so maybe offer to help with the photos.
Zeynep - vegetarian, hates coriander. Works at the council in planning. Has a dog called Pistachio
Stefan and Mabel's wedding is off. They split up about a month ago, he's moved back in with his mum. Don't bring it up with Mabel at book club tomorrow evening.
Adaeze says her sister Chioma is due in March. first grandchild for their mum so she's beside herself
Pick up suit from dry cleaners Saturday morning before 12

Simone mentioned Amara's starting at Bristol uni in a fortnight, doing medicine. Simone's a bit teary about it. I should check in on her the week after Amara goes. Her husband Owen is working away in Aberdeen most of that month too, so she'll be rattling around the house on her own. Maybe invite her for Sunday lunch.
so Kiri's anniversary is tomorrow, five years with Patrick, and he's booked somewhere fancy for dinner at 8. she reckons he might propose. remind me to message her Wednesday morning to find out
Ellie's cat Biscuit had his op today, all fine, home tonight
Tariq got the promotion!! Head of ops from January. Send congrats and maybe a bottle of something
Chloe and Jakub's housewarming is this Saturday from 4. I'm bringing the dessert. Their new place is in Headingley, round the corner from the Co-op.
Anika's mum has her hip replacement next Tuesday at half 8. Anika's taking the week off to look after her. Ring Anika that evening to see how it went
Chen loves bouldering and is learning Spanish, mentioned he'd love a trip to Mexico one day.

Alejandro, aka Ali, is best man at his cousin's wedding in Seville on the 25th. Speech is stressing him out massively. He asked if I'd read a draft. don't forget to send him the link to that speech guide tonight. Also his girlfriend Chloe is flying out separately on the Thursday because of work, and he's worried about getting her from the airport in time for the rehearsal dinner.
Owen and Damian celebrating ten years together this weekend, off to Lisbon Friday after work, back Tuesday
Archie's driving test Friday at 2:40. third attempt. nervous wreck. Text him good luck Friday morning

Oscar's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral likely next week, date TBC. Oscar's dad is taking it hard. I need to send a card and ask Oscar if there's anything I can do. He said his grandad taught him to fish and they used to go to the lake every summer. Oscar's off work all this week. Maybe drop round a lasagne on Wednesday evening so they don't have to cook.
Aleksander's moving to Gdansk in the new year for work, his girlfriend Eva is going too. Leaving do probably early December.
Kai's 30th - he keeps dropping hints about a record player. Party's at the Crown on the 8th, 7pm.
Angela rang. Her son Ben finished his apprenticeship and got kept on full time. She's so proud. Daughter Mabel just passed her grade 5 piano too.
hen do for Simone in Brighton, the weekend of the 14th. I've already paid the deposit. Need to buy the sashes before then
remind me Bao's anniversary w Caitlin = 3rd Nov. she wants a framed print of where they met. sort it the week before
Ben's knee is still bad after the half marathon, physio Wednesday at 4. Bit fed up with it all.

Just off the phone with Yetunde. Long chat. So her and Tariq set the date: 19 June next year, at a barn near Ludlow. Her dad's not well enough to travel far so they've kept it close to home for him. She asked me to do a reading, which I'm honoured by. Her brother Rahul is best man for Tariq, funnily enough. Engagement party is the 30th at their flat, 7ish. Need to sort a present, she mentioned they're saving for a coffee machine.
Ask Zeynep how her viva went. It was yesterday at 2.
Stefan's new job at the bank starts Monday. Seems excited but knackered from the move. He's renting in Clapham now.
Dentist moved to next Thursday 9.15. Car MOT the day after.
Mabel Smith from next door - her husband Patrick is in hospital with pneumonia, been in since Saturday. Offered to walk their dog Rolo. Pop round with soup tomorrow afternoon.
Adaeze got engaged to Kai last night! Ring is her nan's. Wedding probably summer 2028, they're not rushing.
Chen & Anika's little boy Oscar starts nursery Monday morning. Anika's dreading the drop-off more than he is
Simone says Dr Reyes wants to do more tests, results in two weeks. She's trying not to think about it. Check in on her Friday, and again when results are back.

Amara's band is playing the Fleece on Saturday at 9. She's the drummer. Really nervous, first proper gig. I'm going with Patrick. Her mum and dad are coming too, first time they've seen her play live, which is probably half the nerves. Amara asked us to stand near the front and make some noise. Message her after to say how good it was.
Kiri - lactose intolerant, runs Parkrun every Saturday, two kids (Tilly 6, Max 3). Husband Jakub works shifts at the hospital.
Tadhg update: he got the job!! starts the 4th. tell him we're taking him out for a pint Friday at 6
Ellie said her parents are renewing their vows in Cork for their 35th next August. She's helping plan it and wants ideas for a venue. I should send her that hotel her cousin used.
Groceries. Bin day moved to Wednesday this week because of the bank holiday
Rahul Gupta (Rah) - new guy at work, from Leicester, supports Leicester City, mad on cricket. Wife Zeynep is a GP.
Damian's sister Eva had her baby on Tuesday morning! Little girl, Iris. Damian is officially an uncle. Get a card and something small for the baby, drop it off when Eva's home
Owen's audition for the drama school is the 12th at half 9 in Manchester. He's practising his monologue on everyone. I'll drive him there. Remind me to message him the night before
Archie and Chloe's anniversary dinner got cancelled, Chloe's got Covid. They're rescheduling for next Saturday instead.
Jakub's wedding speech went down a storm apparently. Ask him for the video

Talked to Caitlin about Ben's surprise 40th, it's on the 22nd at their place, starts at 8 sharp. Ben's brother Tadhg is flying in from Dublin that afternoon and Caitlin needs someone to pick him up from the airport at 4. Said I would. She's also asked everyone to bring a photo of Ben from the 90s. Do not mention any of this to Ben, he thinks it's a quiet dinner. Remind me to dig out the camping photo this weekend.
Tariq's wife Amara struggling a lot since the miscarriage. He said she's not really leaving the house. I should message her this week, nothing heavy, just to say I'm thinking of her.
Patrick and Kiri are flying to Japan on the 2nd for three weeks. Patrick's mum Angela is minding their cat Noodle.
Alejandro's in-laws arrive Thursday evening and stay till Sunday. He's slightly dreading it lol
Bao turned 50 on Saturday. we missed it, ugh. send something belated. he's into whisky and fishing
Chioma's graduation ceremony Friday at 11 at the Bridgewater Hall. Her mum's flying over from Lagos for it. Don't forget flowers.
Need to book train to Leeds for the 18th, early one, back Sunday evening
Eva & Aleksander - 2nd anniversary 9th Dec. Last year he forgot. She'd love a pottery class voucher (hint hint from her sister Simone).
Stefan's dad is retiring Friday after 40 years at the fire station. There's a do at the station at 5. Stefan asked me along.
Zeynep's PhD funding got extended a year. Huge relief. She's also off to a conference in Toronto next month
Remind me Thursday at lunchtime to ring Yetunde about the wedding playlist, she needs it by the weekend
Mabel nervous about her presentation to the board on Tuesday at 3. Uncle Damian gave her some pointers. Tell her good luck Monday night
Owen, Kai and me - five a side moved to Wednesdays at 7 from now on.

Ellie's brother Archie is getting married in Bali in April!!! She's not sure she can afford the flights. Her other half Oscar thinks they should just go. Ask her in a couple of weeks what they decided.
Rahul's daughter has her first ballet show this weekend, Sunday at 2. He wants to film it but has the night shift Saturday so will be shattered.

Simone and Chen got their keys today! Moving in on the 1st. Their old landlord was a nightmare so she's thrilled. housewarming tbc. Send them that plant. Simone also mentioned her mum is coming down for the whole of the first week to help unpack, which Chen is pretending to be fine about lol. Their cat Mochi hates the car so that'll be a fun journey.

Anika said her nan's 90th is Saturday afternoon, whole family descending on Whitby. Her uncle Patrick is doing a speech. She asked me to help make a slideshow by Friday. Her nan was a seamstress for fifty years and still makes all the grandkids' Halloween costumes. Anika wants old photos from her cousins, and she's chasing them all on the family WhatsApp, which is chaos.

Archie has had a rough week tbh. Split with his girlfriend Sunday, then on Tuesday they announced redundancies at his work. His review is next Monday at 9. His mum has been staying with him. Owen said he's barely eating. I said I'd go round Saturday morning with breakfast and maybe take him out for a walk with the dog. Call him Monday evening after the meeting to see how it went.
